documentation.title: Tags on StackOverflow
documentation.description: Counts of Stack Overflow questions by tag and year, covering 2008--2018. A question can have multiple tags, so summing tag counts does not give the number of distinct questions. The annual total is repeated for each tag's row in a year.

columns.number: Number of questions with tag during year
columns.year_total: Total number of questions across all tags during year
